summary: This Form 8-K reports Quest Diagnostics' issuance of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.000% senior notes due 2036 under a supplemental indenture. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with existing and future senior unsecured debt, with no sinking fund. Interest is payable semi-annually beginning December 30, 2026, and the notes mature June 30, 2036. A change-of-control triggering event requires an offer to repurchase at 101% of principal plus accrued interest. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. What to watch: none.
